rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the eg-over-t2g irrep selection (λ_eg=0.897 > λ_t2g=0.798) and the strong-coupling trend toward TR-symmetric real d-wave, both matching the paper's claims. However, the headline weak-coupling claim—that the TR-breaking (1,i) state is the ground state—is contradicted by the condensation-energy proxy (q2<0 favoring real nodal state). The replicator correctly identifies this as a methodological limitation: the exact one-loop GL quartic with projected gaps was not implemented. Key topological features (Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces, Chern numbers) and the full phase diagram were not built, capping coverage.
